review_type: Scientific report text and interpretation review against completed independent numerical audits
scope: Reported values and counts checked against previously completed independent audits and their audited tables.
Primary margin criteria, secondary comparisons, matched-bank loss decomposition, actual-rank interpretation, certificate allocation and certificate utility reviewed.
Scientific prose reviewed for accurate scope, limitations and distinction between empirical improvement and certified improvement.
conclusions: No substantive numerical or inferential error remains in the reviewed report.
Three of six forecasting primary criteria are established; the complete criterion is not established.
Dimension selection improves the principal nonlinear aggregate without establishing stronger KAHM-specific reconstruction gains or broad superiority over competitors.
The certificate study reports unchanged selected-forecast tolerance decisions and no positive dimension-policy improvement certificate.
Approximate paired-t inference, finite-sample certificate guarantees, consistency diagnostics and descriptive comparisons are appropriately distinguished.
The report presents scientific findings and limitations in a manner suitable for a TMLR research discussion; this is not an editorial acceptance assessment.
